- **`lib/catalog/search.js`:** the sort now compares `filingTitle(...)` of each title. It still uses `localeCompare`.
- **`test/catalog.test.js`:** the existing sort test now expects "The Left Hand of Darkness" between "Chromebook 14" and "National Geographic…".

Titles like "A.I." or a title that is only "The" are left as they are, because no space and further text follow the article.

I tried to run my first edit as one combined shell command, and the permission check denied it. I redid it with the edit tools instead, so nothing was lost.

I haven't committed anything.
